concept.literalSynthesis: A long, two-handed jester's musket launches bright fallen stars, with each true hit scattering a smaller guiding star from the impact point. The fanciful weapon identity and the consumable night-sky star stay visible in the design.
concept.coreMechanic: A reusable ranged musket fires one 31-damage shot every 32 ticks and consumes one selected fallen-star ammo unit for each accepted shot. Its projectile travels quickly, then curves downward under explicit gravity; on an actual NPC hit it releases one separate, weaker star that slowly steers toward a nearby valid NPC. The child is authored independently and can deal at most one hit before ending. The pair adds an impact follow-up to the parent's straight, piercing shot, while its one-use ammunition cost makes repeated volleys draw on a consumable resource. Fallen Star's -1 damage is a native sentinel, not a measured ammo damage contribution, and its 17-tick use time does not set the musket's firing cadence. No acquisition tier is inferred from the source rarity, value, or recipe depth.
concept.parentAContribution: The jester's musket supplies the firearm identity, ranged class, 31 base damage, 5.25 knockback, 32-tick use and animation timing, and the 9-pixel-per-tick launch-speed reference. Its observed ammo category was fallen_star. The authored gravity arc and hit-triggered child add new mechanics rather than claims about the source musket's observed behavior.
concept.parentBContribution: The Fallen Star supplies the actual consumable ammo category and the star form for the smaller follow-up projectile. Its damage is -1, a native sentinel rather than evidence of a damaging standalone weapon, and its own use time is not a launcher cadence. The weapon therefore supplies its own damage and rate while requiring the star as a spent resource.
concept.playerExperience: Aim and fire the visible musket as a reusable weapon. Each accepted shot spends a fallen star, follows a deliberate downward arc, and can create one slower homing follow-up only when the main projectile hits an NPC. The ammo cost funds the added hit; a miss creates no child.

plannedPlayerActions.intent: Aim the musket at a target and fire one gravity-curving shot, consuming fallen-star ammunition; a confirmed NPC hit releases a weaker, slowly homing star.

realization.description: Fire the two-handed musket toward the cursor. Each accepted shot consumes one fallen star and launches a fast star that curves downward. If it hits an NPC, one smaller star appears at the impact and slowly homes toward a nearby valid NPC. The musket is reusable; the ammunition is not refunded on a miss.
realization.playerExperience: The main shot can pierce one NPC after its first hit, so a hit may release a follow-up star; the follow-up has a shorter life and only one hit. Fallen-star supply limits sustained firing.
realization.selfEvaluation: The root and child each own their required damage, lifetime, hitbox, collision, and movement calls. The child event is an acyclic on_hit edge from the root. The weapon consumes fallen-star ammunition through its active spawn binding and is not configured as an ammunition item.
